dependency_rule: Install every pinned public requirements.txt line except fastapi itself; install the buggy checkout editable without dependencies. The fixed checkout is validator-only and is not installed as the active package.
environment_deviation: Public metadata specifies Python 3.8.3; pinned official Python 3.8.20 is used. All public test nodes are run separately in the same image. No LLM outcome informed the environment.
public_test_rule: Run every distinct pytest node from run_test.sh; each node must belong to a declared test_file path
selection_rule: First two reproducible cases in frozen hash order; retain every exclusion
